SRC-001:R1.text: Ship exactly three features: five-minute trials for unowned premium sounds, five-minute trials for unowned premium themes, and one compact home-screen START/STOP widget.

SRC-001:R10.text: Pre-flight fix 3: effective theme selection falls back to Classic when the premium entitlement is unavailable.

SRC-001:R11.text: Pre-flight fix 4: a successful Billing refresh does not leave an obsolete previous store error.

SRC-001:R12.text: One small Android-independent trial model (TrialAccess, TrialClock, trial state) instead of a large architecture.

SRC-001:R13.text: Trial ids are the existing content ids; sound_original, theme_classic and theme_pack never get trial ids.

SRC-001:R14.text: Premium theme trial ids are theme_terminal, theme_phosphor, theme_midnight, theme_amber and theme_pink.

SRC-001:R15.text: Ownership and trial access stay separate concepts; BillingRepository never believes trial items are owned.

SRC-001:R16.text: Trial expiry survives Activity recreation, process death and app restart, persisted as wall-clock epoch millis in the existing DataStore.

SRC-001:R17.text: No Room, no second database and no WorkManager.

SRC-001:R18.text: Stored trial ids are validated against the trialable catalog and expired entries may be pruned lazily.

SRC-001:R19.text: Time is injectable at the pure logic boundary; System.currentTimeMillis() is not scattered through UI, catalog or service code.

SRC-001:R2.text: No subscription or licensing framework and no widget platform; all accepted core, service, billing, lifecycle and background behaviour preserved.

SRC-001:R20.text: One process-level coordinator schedules only the next relevant expiration and recomputes access, with no one-second ticker, no AlarmManager and no exact alarms.

SRC-001:R21.text: startTrial rejects non-trialable ids, creates nothing for purchased content, returns the existing expiry while active, otherwise stores now+300000.

SRC-001:R22.text: Access rule: a sound is accessible if free or purchased or in an active trial; a theme if free or Themes Pack is owned or in an active trial.

SRC-001:R23.text: The main screen shows all catalog sounds with compact TRY 5 MIN / TRIAL mm:ss / OWNED / INCLUDED labels in the existing visual language.

SRC-001:R4.text: Repeated selection of an already active trial never extends its expiration.

SRC-001:R5.text: After expiry an unowned sound becomes unavailable and an unowned theme stops rendering, with Classic effective again.

SRC-001:R6.text: Trials are reusable rather than one-time: after expiry the same content may start another five-minute trial.

SRC-001:R7.text: No cooldowns, counters, accounts, device IDs, server validation or anti-abuse logic.

SRC-001:R8.text: Pre-flight fix 1: an active session never initializes audio from a synthetic default Settings().

SRC-001:R9.text: Pre-flight fix 2: SoundPool load completion cannot be lost in an immediate callback race and startup cannot stay suspended forever.
